Some.String: Default tool for web research and finding sources. Search with DeepSeek and return titles, URLs and query-relevant summaries. Search first, then use web_fetch to read selected pages. need_content defaults to false; request full content only when needed.

Some.String: Default tool for reading a webpage URL. Fetch through DeepSeek and return its title, source URL and extracted Markdown content. Use this for webpage reading instead of requesting raw HTML with http_request.
